chunk_map.heading: The summary reads better than the evidence

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 0 "The summary reads better than the evidence": L4 "That is the warning sign" resolves to the preceding clause (summary reads better than interviews); L4 "Two ways it happens" is followed by "It stretches." L6 / "It smooths." L8; L10 "its source" binds to "each line a decision rests on". No pronoun without an in-chunk antecedent.

rules_evaluated.na_reason: no pointer to another file or earlier deck position

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no "the X you did/saw" reference; examples at L6 and L8 are hypotheticals introduced in-chunk

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L6 "One ticket: a customer complained about the export. The summary: customers are unhappy with exporting." and L8 "Two interviews disagree: one customer wants fewer steps..." Closest to a muted-read noun stack, but each colon sets a full verbed sentence (complained, disagree, wants), no guess cue, no terminal-pointing pronoun, no reveal ahead of a guess.
L4-10 chunk carries a self-sufficient claim, two mechanisms and a closing move; not a wait-state slide.

Header "The summary reads better than the evidence" vs L4 "often reads better" and L4 "That is the warning sign". Header is unscoped where the body says "often", closest to contradiction; the first body sentence restates the header with the scope, and the maintainer block records the choice, so the header is true as the slide summary and not contradicted.

L6 "It stretches." / L8 "It smooths." is a pair, not a triplet; no "Not X. Not Y. Z." (grep '^Not ' → 0 in body), no superlative, no number + retraction, no abstraction-noun stack ("claimed more than it can carry" is concrete). Closest: L8 "one clean need" is concrete.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No repo/authorial vocabulary in L1-10; "source", "summary", "interviews", "ticket" are the engineer-room terms. Maintainer-block words (squint, mechanism) sit below the cut at L14-16.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: bold count in body = 0 (grep -c "\*\*" over L1-11 → 0); within budget.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: slide file composed by its including lecture; presence is a renderer/include question, no phase-less section here

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no Phase/Step headers; check-slide-numbering.js --file → OK, exit 0

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js --file curriculum/slides/the-source-says-less.md → "OK — 1 files, no page-geometry pointers across the slide cut." exit 0; no below/above in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file curriculum/slides/the-source-says-less.md → oversized: 0, "every slide is within limits"; body is ~119 words incl. maintainer so under 210, zero bullets.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L1 "The summary reads better than the evidence" is a declarative claim, matching the lecture-heading grammar; not an exercise heading.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: L10 "For each line a decision rests on, ask how much its source actually says." It could read as a kicker, but it adds the move (ask per decision line how much its source says) that nothing earlier states; L4 "That is the warning sign" names the tell, not a restated header. No doctrine restatement or design commentary.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no header rename recorded; maintainer STATUS describes a fresh rebuild, not a retitle over inherited bullets
